==Transportation==
The Giants' Foundry is located in a cave beneath the [[Giants' Plateau]]. Players can get there by using:

* Using [[Minigame Teleport]] through the spellbook or the [[Grouping]] tab to the Giants' Foundry
* An [[amulet of glory]] teleport to the [[Al Kharid]] [[Al Kharid Palace|Palace]]
* A [[ring of dueling]] teleport to the [[Emir's Arena]]
* The [[gnome glider]] flight to Kar-Hewo
* The [[Al Kharid gate|toll gate]] from [[Lumbridge]]
